model_syntax:
# =======================================
  # Reflective Measurement Model
  # =======================================
  Attitude =~ att_appealing + att_desirable +
              att_goodidea + att_pleasant
  PBC =~ pbc_barrier + pbc_could +
         pbc_resources
  SocialNorms =~ norms_d_many + norms_d_common +
                  norms_d_few + 
                  norms_i_consider + norms_i_bad +
                  norms_i_support


  Symbolism =~ symb_envresp + symb_modern
  AoC =~ aoc_transport + aoc_overstated + aoc_minor
  BEnv =~ ben_env_reduce + ben_env_shift + ben_env_nodiff
  
  Inst_trust =~ reactance_interfere + reactance_rulesharm + reactance_commongood + reactance_individual + 
                antiintel_commonsense + antiintel_facts + antiintel_expertshelp

  Intention =~ nextv_bev + nextv_phev + nextv_icev


  # =======================================
  # Structural path
  # ======================================= 
  Intention ~ d1*Attitude + PBC + d2*SocialNorms  
  Attitude ~  b1*BEnv + Symbolism + e1*Inst_trust
  BEnv ~ a*AoC
  AoC ~ g*Inst_trust
  SocialNorms ~  Symbolism

  # AoC on Attitude
  ind_tot_aoc_att := a*b1

  # AoC on Intention
  ind_tot_aoc_int := a*b1*d1
  
  # New **institutional trust** on Attitude and Intention
  
  dir_it_att := e1
  ind_it_aoc_benv_att := g*a*b1
  tot_it_att := e1 + g*a*b1
  
  ind_tot_it_int := (e1 + g*a*b1)*d1 

  # =======================================
  # Covariance path
  # ======================================= 
  Attitude ~~ PBC
  Attitude ~~ SocialNorms
  SocialNorms ~~ PBC

  SocialNorms ~~ AoC
  SocialNorms ~~ BEnv
  
  BEnv ~~ PBC
  BEnv ~~ Symbolism
  
  # New endo ~~ exo paths in the presence of dispositional account
  SocialNorms ~~ Inst_trust

  # New endo ~~ exo paths due to AoC becoming an endo compared to 2.2.1a
  AoC ~~ PBC
  AoC ~~ Symbolism

  # In addition, all exo ~~ exo allowed with auto.cov.lv.x = TRUE
